description: Read own-site keywords, opportunities at average positions 4–20, up to 20 tracked queries and daily history. Check dates, partial coverage and collection failure before proposing edits. These are not market search volumes. The sample covers 28 days, at most 50 queries and 50 pages. Use queries for keyword research and opportunities for average positions 4–20. The terms array adds daily history and 7-day comparisons for up to 20 selected queries. Coverage is partial: impressions are for this property, not market search volume. Positions are impression-weighted averages, not fixed SERP ranks. Credentials and raw provider responses are not returned.
